# Sea Society Ibiza

> Luxury yacht charter from Botafoc Marina, Ibiza. Day, sunset and multi-day charters across the Balearic Islands aboard a curated fleet of 19 motor yachts, 14–50 m, from Pershing, Sunseeker, Mangusta, Princess, Riva, Arcadia and more.

Sea Society Ibiza ("Sea Society", "the agency") is an Ibiza-based luxury yacht charter agency. We do not own the fleet — we are an experienced concierge that books bareboat and crewed charters on behalf of guests, handling itinerary planning, captain coordination, provisioning and on-water hospitality. All charters depart from Botafoc Marina (Marina Ibiza). Common destinations from Ibiza: Formentera (Playa de Ses Illetes, Espalmador), the Ibiza coastline (Cala Bassa, Cala Comte, Cala Salada), Mallorca, and overnight cruising between islands. Prices start at approximately €1,200/day for smaller open-deck cruisers and scale upward for larger crewed yachts; multi-day rates available on enquiry. The brand operates in English, French, German, Spanish and Dutch.
